subject: c-cult-at
title: C.CULT.AT.-----RT.DY.
description: First of two diagrams in R(AS)CM(II)-31 (Reality Aspect of Creative Music, Level Two — Agents). The facing prose names the structural ground: 'most creative musicians work with one of the two or three jazz booking agencies available, or work independently. This is understandable, since the jazz agencies can handle only so many musicians... But the Jack Whitmores are few in between, and the actual reality of most creative musicians is to function as both musician and agent.' The crossing diagrams what that double-functioning is structurally crossing: C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) is crossed with RT-DY (reality dynamics — what booking, touring, contracting actually require). C-CULT-AT sits at the upper left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-right to RT-DY. Three lines leave the main line: one runs down-left to CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis), with JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) branching from it, IST-F (isolated focus) branching in turn from JR-DYM, and a vertical dropping from it to MOT-DY at the lower center; one rises up-right to SOC-RT (social reality), with UPB (underlying philosophical basis) branching from it; and one drops straight down to PART (participation), with OP-SD (option spread) branching from it to the right and POL-SIGN (political significance) branching in turn from OP-SD.
